entry.description: Where the phone starts: the runtime made ready for core, then Expo Router's root layout and one thin route for each Place. Expo Router reaches the routes itself, so nothing imports them

screens.description: What the user sees on a phone: the shell around every Place (Splash, signed-out card, header, Sidebar with the User Switcher, Local Sign-In, the Commands, and the layer gestures mount in), each Place, the Add and Accounts sheets, and the parts they share
The shell holds the frame and opens the sheets over it; each Place is its own module a route opens, and Entries opens the Accounts sheet to rename one; all of them draw with the shared parts

ledger.description: Ledger on the phone, made once from core on expo-toolkit's platform with this build's cloud addresses, with the theme and how Ledger feels: what every screen uses

runtime.description: What Hermes lacks that core expects of a runtime, put in place before anything else loads: crypto.randomUUID and getRandomValues, and the ES2023 change-array-by-copy methods

ledger-expo.description: Read top-down: entry readies the runtime and routes to the screens; the screens stand on Ledger from src/ledger, made on expo-toolkit's platform. Everything shared with the web app is in @ledger/core; generic native UI, gestures, feedback and the platform are in @kstackz/expo-toolkit
